channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Peyton Watson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Peyton Watson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Peyton Watson
item.description:
Donovan Mitchell:

“I think we could be a top-five defense. I believe that at our, when I first got here, our first two years we were a top-ten, wasn’t it? Something like that. I think there’s people we’ve added, like Peyton. I think a full year of camp and kind of trying not to give too much, but things we’ve added, things we’ve done, I think it kind of helped with that as well. Last year we changed some things, and then also adding James, we were trying to change stuff on the fly. I think this year coming in, I’m really excited about what we can do as far as protecting our paint, protecting ourselves, protecting each other out there on the floor. I think we’ll do a better job, that’s for sure.”

Donovan Mitchell on Peyton Watson, Oct 7, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Mario Hezonja, Peyton Watson, Jaylon Tyson
item.description:
Donovan Mitchell:

“The biggest thing is our length, our versatility. Adding a guy like Peyton Watson changes us in a major way. Obviously you have Jaylon Tyson on the perimeter as well, even Mario Hezonja. Just our size, our athleticism, being able to implement different coverages, different schemes, I think will definitely be able to help us come down the stretch. Not be so one track minded defensively and obviously having Evan and Jaylen, they do their thing back there for us as always and they lead us. But I think with the addition of Peyton and Tyson, I think those two are going to elevate us from the perimeter spot.”

Donovan Mitchell on Mario Hezonja, Peyton Watson, Jaylon Tyson, Oct 1, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Koby Altman on Peyton Watson
item.description:
president of basketball operations Koby Altman said.

“It’s rare and unique that you have an opportunity to add a player of that upside, that magnitude to this group. Every minute he’s been out on the basketball floor has been with an eye towards playoffs. With all those meaningful reps, he comes to our team in the same vein. We’re trying to win a championship. He understands the importance of possessions. He understands the importance of teamwork and how you build toward the ultimate success. We’re really high on Peyton.”

Koby Altman on Peyton Watson, Sep 29, 2026. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: Ben Tenzer on Peyton Watson
item.description:
Bennet Durando:Ben Tenzer:

“Peyton (Watson) did a lot of great things here. Great player. Great person.”

Ben Tenzer on Peyton Watson, Sep 28, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Peyton Watson, James Harden
item.description:
Koby Altman and Kenny Atkinson on James Harden:

“He wanted us to put the best roster together to win a championship. He helped us recruit Peyton Watson. He helped us get under the first apron. He wants to win. He’s been unselfish since he arrived here.”

Kenny Atkinson on Peyton Watson, James Harden, Sep 25, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Aaron Gordon on Peyton Watson
item.description:
Aaron Gordon on Peyton Watson:

“That's my dog. It's deeper than basketball with Peyton and I. Our family members go to the same church. Peyton is like my brother. Happy for him, the situation that he's in.”

Aaron Gordon on Peyton Watson, Sep 14, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Ognjen Stojakovic on Peyton Watson
item.description:
“First of all, Peyton is a great, great kid, very talented, super talented, good personality, playing hard, all those, I mean, of course, losing someone like someone who was drafted by our organization. So, of course, losing someone like that, it’s not easy,”

Ognjen Stojakovic on Peyton Watson, Sep 5, 2026. Source: Basketball Network.

item.title: Cam Johnson on Peyton Watson
item.description:
Cam Johnson:

“Let's just take the elephant in the room. Peyton Watson is in contract negotiations. The only reason that we're in this position in the first place is because he balled out. He played really well. So you see that, and it's just like you want your guys to play well. You want your guys to make top dollar, and then you get to the end of the road and it becomes very like, oh man, now everybody can't get paid crazy.”

Cam Johnson on Peyton Watson, Jul 14, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Porter Jr. on Aaron Gordon, Peyton Watson
item.description:
“I'm going to say my prediction is that if everyone gets healthy on the Nuggets — Peyton Watson broke out this year and Aaron Gordon is a difference maker — once they get healthy for the playoffs, it's going to be really, really hard to beat them in seven games,”

Porter Jr. on Aaron Gordon, Peyton Watson, Mar 9, 2026. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: David Adelman on Peyton Watson
item.description:
coach David Adelman said in New Orleans.

“I think what will happen is, as guys come back and the minutes go up and the restrictions are off certain people, we’ll have to feel out who we are as a team again. And that’ll be, we know we have something new with Peyton that he’s been able to do. And then you just add it to the package of guys that have come off the bench, are in the rotation. And I have to look back at these games and see what actually works. A lot of this stuff was patchwork as we went. Out-of-timeout plays. Just trying to get them in spots where they can be successful. And we’ve found some things.”

David Adelman on Peyton Watson, Jan 14, 2026. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: David Adelman on Peyton Watson, Spencer Jones
item.description:
“I think sometimes it’s on me. There’s some confusion (about) who’s going to be in the dunker, who’s in the corner with Peyton and Spencer. Both guys can do those roles well.“But I’ve really enjoyed the energy. I think the screening, some of the fundamental stuff that we preach, Peyton and Spence have done a great job of that, freeing people up, setting screens.”

David Adelman on Peyton Watson, Spencer Jones, Dec 17, 2025. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Michael Malone on Peyton Watson
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Michael Malone:

“I think Peyton Watson’s going to have a hell of a playoffs.”

Michael Malone on Peyton Watson, Apr 17, 2024. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Peyton Watson
item.description:
Durant told The Denver Post.

“So we were bringing guys every day. And I think that day, Peyton had came in, and guys might’ve canceled on us that day. So we just played full-court 3-on-3. …We weren’t expecting anything out of anybody. Just playing hard and just having an honest hoop game. He came in and fit right in.”

Kevin Durant on Peyton Watson, Mar 25, 2024. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Michael Malone on Peyton Watson
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Michael Malone on playing Peyton Watson in crunch time:

“The only way he can get better in those situations is by being in them…he’s shown me he has the ability to guard some of the best players in the NBA.”

Michael Malone on Peyton Watson, Dec 25, 2023. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Michael Malone on Peyton Watson
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Michael Malone on Peyton Watson:

“I met with Peyton the other day, and I told him I felt he came into this season assuming he was going to get backup minutes.”

Michael Malone on Peyton Watson, Oct 26, 2023. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.
